raw_text: 055型驱逐舰延安号通过马六甲海峡进入印度洋。补给舰随行。Type 055 Yan'an confirmed Malacca transit. PLAN task group forming in eastern Indian Ocean. Commercial ship spotters report visual confirmation near One Fathom Bank. Indian Navy surveillance expected.
